metadata.title: Successful Recovery
metadata.narrative: Issuer decline on a card payment, but this customer has already paid successfully with a different method before. RecoverAI diagnoses the decline, selects switch_payment_method, simulates the retry, and independently verifies the result.

metadata.title: Supporting history
metadata.narrative: Not a showcase case on its own — this prior successful UPI payment is what gives demo_txn_01 its 'already succeeded with an alternate method' signal.

metadata.title: No Action Needed
metadata.narrative: The payment already succeeded. Detection stops the pipeline immediately — nothing downstream runs, because there is nothing to recover.

metadata.title: Retry Limit Blocked
metadata.narrative: Three failed attempts already recorded. Detection marks this transaction as reaching the retry cap and blocks it outright — RecoverAI refuses to keep hammering a payment method that keeps failing.

metadata.title: Manual Review Required
metadata.narrative: An ambiguous processor error — not enough of a clear signal to pick an automated recovery action. Diagnosis and Strategy both escalate to manual_review, and the Recovery Execution Policy blocks it outright: a human has to look at this one. No money moves.

metadata.title: Pending Human Approval
metadata.narrative: Insufficient funds on a high-value transaction. Strategy selects manual_followup, which requires a human's approval before it can run — the plan is recorded, but execution stays pending. Still simulation-only, still no money moved.
